entries.name: Don Cotton

expected.charges: Wisconsin state burglary, arson, theft — September 24, 1968 Milwaukee 14 draft-board raid
expected.sentence:
2 years Wisconsin state prison; paroled at 14 months

Verdict as recorded: Yes — Wisconsin state jury verdict, May 1969

entries.rationale: Visually inspected June6 1969 sentencing transcript pp6-10 (PDF215-219). Individual sentences, denial of stay/bail, removal into custody and discharge of bondsman establish sentencing and post-conviction custody June6. Higgenbotham adjourned; Cullen/Gardner separately tried. Existing release dates and earlier1968 pretrial episodes remain unresolved, not validated by this change.
